description: The measures MotionLab reports, one entry each. The server reads this file (server/app/services/metrics_catalog.py); the web app and the feedback module word figures from it. Units: SW is one shoulder width (body frame, origin at the affected shoulder); angles in degrees; hand distances as ratios of palm length; times in ms.

metrics.name: Reach area
metrics.description: Area of the convex hull of the reach calibration, in square shoulder widths.

metrics.name: Reaction time
metrics.description: Target shown to movement onset: the filtered fingertip speed first above 0.15 SW/s for 50 ms.

metrics.name: Movement time
metrics.description: Movement onset to reaching the target (entering it, popping the balloon, the basket under the fruit, or reaching the object).

metrics.name: Path efficiency
metrics.description: Straight distance over the length of the RAW path, 0-1; 1 is perfectly straight. Sideways only for fruit_catch; the carry for pick_place.

metrics.name: Smoothness (SPARC)
metrics.description: Spectral arc length of the RAW fingertip speed during the movement (Balasubramanian et al. 2015); 0 or less, closer to 0 is smoother.

metrics.name: Peak speed
metrics.description: The highest filtered fingertip speed during the movement, in SW per second.

metrics.name: Speed peaks per movement
metrics.description: Distinct peaks of the filtered speed (each standing out by more than 10% of the highest); a smooth movement has one.

metrics.name: Compensation rate
metrics.description: Share of trials with compensation flagged (trunk, lean, shoulder hike or upper arm), leaving out trials the patient stopped.

metrics.name: Shoulder raise forward: best angle
metrics.description: The highest arm angle forward from the body in the warm-up.

metrics.name: Shoulder raise sideways: best angle
metrics.description: The highest arm angle sideways from the body in the warm-up.

metrics.name: Elbow range
metrics.description: Most straight minus most bent elbow angle reached in a stripe of Paint the wall.

metrics.name: Forward reach: best ratio
metrics.description: The farthest forward reach in the warm-up, as a share of arm length.

metrics.name: Hand opening range
metrics.source: warmupresult (hand_open_close): best_peak minus the low threshold
metrics.description: How far the hand opened beyond its closed level in the warm-up, in palm lengths.

metrics.name: Finger piano hit rate
metrics.description: Notes played with the right finger in time over notes asked, 0-1.

metrics.name: Grip steadiness
metrics.description: Standard deviation of the grip level while inside the green band, 0-1; smaller is steadier.

metrics.name: Relaxation time
metrics.description: The relax prompt to the grip level first falling below the relax level.

metrics.name: Pick-and-place transport time
metrics.description: The last grasp to letting go inside the box, for objects placed.

metrics.name: Bloom peak openness
metrics.description: The widest the hand opened for a flower, 0 (fist) to 1 (fully open).

metrics.name: Overall game success rate
metrics.description: Successful trials over all trials of every game, leaving out trials the patient stopped.

metrics.name: Active minutes
metrics.source: warm-up active time plus each finished game run's time
metrics.description: Time spent on warm-up exercises and games, in minutes.

metrics.name: Warm-up repetitions
metrics.description: Warm-up repetitions done in full, over all exercises.

metrics.name: Warm-up goals reached
metrics.description: Warm-up exercises whose goal was reached.

metrics.name: Pain
metrics.description: Self-reported pain after the session, 0 (none) to 10.

metrics.name: Fatigue
metrics.description: Self-reported tiredness after the session, 0 (none) to 10.

metrics.name: Enjoyment
metrics.description: Self-reported enjoyment of the session, 1 to 5.
